title: Product gallery modal focus correction prepared locally
summary: One-file candidate preserves the live Search Overlay release. Validation pending; no deployment authorized.

changes.detail: Focus close control on opening, contain Tab/Shift+Tab and background focus, isolate existing/late body siblings, restore original inert/overflow priority and exact opening button including touch. Separate modal lifetime from image navigation shortcuts to retain focus during image changes. Existing labels, media, navigation, zoom/pan/swipe and product logic retained.

validation.name: Audit and source scope
validation.detail: Existing audit shows focus remains on background trigger and escapes modal. Only ProductGallery differs from 2055-file Search Overlay baseline.
